lastCompletedStory.title: Wire check-test-sleeps as gate #13 and bump both gate-count freeze tests

nextStoryContext: US-007 closes the CAM-305 PRD: check-test-sleeps.ts is now wired as the 13th and final entry in scripts/check-all.ts's GATES array (g('test-sleeps', 'bun scripts/check-test-sleeps.ts')), appended after agents-md. Both frozen gate-count registries were bumped in lockstep: test/check-all.test.ts (toHaveLength(12)->13, new positional GATES[12] name/cmd/args test, both onResults name-list tests extended with 'test-sleeps') and test/gates-manifest.test.ts (toHaveLength(12)->13, new CAM305_GATES = ['test-sleeps'] as const group with its own membership test, combined expected-names list extended, header comment + describe/test titles updated to 13). Repo-wide grep confirmed these two files are the only toHaveLength(12) freeze points; scripts/validate-agents-md.ts was untouched (no gate-count assertion there, as flagged by the prior story's handoff). scripts/check-all.ts grew 174->175 lines and test/check-all.test.ts grew 391->399 lines, both exceeding their file-size-budget.json ceilings; raised both ceilings to the actual gate-measured counts (175, 399) with a dated US-007/CAM-305 _ref note prepended before the file-size gate, staged in the same commit. Verified: bun scripts/check-test-sleeps.ts (zero violations, unchanged from US-006's fully-migrated tree), bun run typecheck (0 errors), bun test (4593 tests, 0 fail), and bun run check:all (all 13 gates green, exit 0). This is the LAST story in the CAM-305 sleep-migration PRD arc (US-001 through US-007); whatever the next story is, it is either a new unrelated PRD or an operator-driven follow-up.
